testSuite.details: python3 -m pytest -q (repo root) => 1083 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed, 0 errors in ~14s. Matches known-green baseline exactly (1083/2/0). The 2 skips are explicit conditional skips with reasons (tests/test_mattel_news_source.py:613 'live listing snapshot not available', :629 'live article snapshot not available') — pre-existing, unrelated to this feature, motivated. Feature test files alone: 143 passed (tests/test_model_extractor.py, test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup + TestFingerprintCarryThrough, test_pending_articles_repo.py, test_migration.py, test_admin_alerts.py, test_backfill_fingerprints.py).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC1 (user): Each new article with paragraphs gets a model_fingerprint extracted and stored in pending_articles.model_fingerprint as JSON.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_model_extractor.py::TestExtractFingerprint (18 tests) proves extraction; tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestInsertPendingFingerprint::test_insert_pending_with_fingerprint_roundtrip proves storage+JSON roundtrip. DEVIATION: shape is dict {"strict":[...],"brands":[...]} not list[str]. Approved — tech-spec '## User-Spec Deviations' ('Refined: Fingerprint shape is dict, not list [APPROVED]') + Decision 4/5; operator confirmed AC8/AC9/AC10 two-level granularity intent during user-spec phase. Smoke: extract_fingerprint({'title':'2018 Toyota 4Runner gold chase','paragraphs':['Subaru Legacy GT (BP).']}) => {'strict':['subaru legacy gt','toyota 4runner'],'brands':['subaru','toyota']}.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC2 (user): On publish, model_fingerprint moves into published_articles.model_fingerprint with the rest of the article fields.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestFingerprintCarryThrough::test_pending_to_published_roundtrip — inserts pending row with dict fingerprint, calls move_to_published, SELECTs raw published_articles.model_fingerprint, asserts json.loads(stored) == fp. Source: pending_articles_repo.move_to_published carries the column (Task 4 deviation, two-line SELECT/INSERT column addition, documented in decisions.md Task 4).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC3 (user): Hard-block at >=50% overlap — article NOT inserted into pending; link goes to processed_news; INFO log; quiet [E015] ping.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup::test_hard_block_path — second article NOT in pending, link present in processed_news (Decision 8 mark_processed), E015 ping fired (asserted via mock call_args_list). E015 builder: tests/test_admin_alerts.py::test_e015_cross_source_blocked.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC4 (user): Soft-flag at 30-49% — article published; operator gets [E014] columnar Russian ping with shared model list.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup::test_soft_flag_path — both articles inserted, exactly one E014 fired. E014 builder format: tests/test_admin_alerts.py::test_e014_cross_source_dupe (asserts code prefix, emoji, key substrings, model list).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC5 (user): Ping-noise guard — same (new_link, existing_link) pair pings E014 at most once per 7 days; state in bot_state.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup::test_soft_flag_rate_limited (second identical pair within window => no second E014). Unit: tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestPairRateLimit — within_window_true, after_window_false (backdated bot_state row, no time.sleep), independent_pairs, corrupted_timestamp_does_not_block. State stored in bot_state via softflag_pair:{new}\n{existing} key (Decision 6).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC6 (user): Empty fingerprint on new article => dedup skipped; DB stores [] (here {"strict":[],"brands":[]}), not NULL.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup::test_empty_fingerprint (article with no brands passes through, fingerprint {"strict":[],"brands":[]} stored, no comparison). Unit: tests/test_model_extractor.py::TestSimilarity::test_empty_fp_returns_zero + test_both_empty_returns_zero (Decision 4 empty-fp guard returns 0.0). Storage distinct-from-NULL: tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestInsertPendingFingerprint::test_insert_pending_with_empty_fingerprint_roundtrip.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC7 (user): Comparison runs against ALL sources — within-source republishes also caught.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup::test_within_source_dedup — two articles from SAME source_name with 100% overlap => second blocked (pins Decision 9 no-source-filter).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC8 (user): Anti-false-100% — if either fp has only 1 model, compare on strict models only; brand-only fallback only when both have >=2 distinct brands.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_model_extractor.py::TestSimilarity::test_one_token_strict_both_sides_no_brand_fallback, ::test_one_strict_one_brand_each, ::test_two_strict_one_brand_each (brand-count guard boundary). Source: model_extractor.similarity guards len<=1 and brands<2 (Decision 4). Fixture probe: cross_source_dedup_pairs.py Pair 5 (same-brand-different-model) + Pair 6 (1-token both sides), both classified non-dupe in test_calibration_accuracy.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC9 (user): Extractor/compare crash => article still published (degraded mode); ERROR log with traceback; channel unaffected.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup::test_degraded_mode — extract_fingerprint patched to raise; article still inserted (model_fingerprint NULL), exactly one rate-limited E016 fired with exception class name, second job() within hour fires zero E016, second article still published. try/except Exception wrap = Decision 12. E016 builder: tests/test_admin_alerts.py::test_e016_dedup_degraded.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC10 (user): Schema migration auto-runs at init_db() via try/except sqlite3.OperationalError; re-run on migrated DB is a no-op.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_migration.py::TestMigration::test_init_schema_idempotent + test_init_db_idempotent (double-call, no raise, both columns present). Live smoke: double init_schema on :memory: => pending model_fingerprint True, published model_fingerprint True, no exception. Source: pending_articles_repo.init_schema ALTER block in try/except OperationalError (Decision 11).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC11 (user): backfill_fingerprints.py walks last 14d published_articles, derives fingerprint, writes new column; idempotent; logs summary.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_backfill_fingerprints.py: test_idempotency_second_run_processed_zero, test_days_window_honored, test_summary_structure, test_fetch_empty_stores_computed_empty, test_fetch_exception_leaves_null, test_days_clamp_rejects_out_of_range[*]. DEVIATION: paragraphs are re-fetched via news_bot.fetch_full_article (Path A) because published_articles does NOT store paragraphs. Approved — tech-spec '## User-Spec Deviations' + Decision 10 ([APPROVED 2026-06-04]). Idempotency marker: WHERE model_fingerprint IS NULL. Dry-run smoke on fresh empty DB: exit 0, full summary block (Window/Processed/Skipped/Empty fp/Errors/Duration), DB md5 unchanged before==after (zero writes).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC12 (user): Calibration fixture with 8 labelled pairs (4 dupes incl. real 2026-06-03, 4 non-dupes incl. AC8 probe + 1-token guard); classifier >=7/8 correct.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/fixtures/cross_source_dedup_pairs.py (4 DUPE_PAIRS incl. Pair 1 real 2026-06-03 t-hunted<->autoevolution; 4 NON_DUPE incl. Pair 5 same-brand-diff-model, Pair 6 1-token guard, Pair 8 industry-news empty-fp). tests/test_model_extractor.py::test_calibration_accuracy (>=7/8 floor; decisions.md Task 1 reports actual 8/8) + ::test_calibration_real_pair_must_pass (Pair 1 must classify duplicate; T8 M1 hardened to assert classifier verdict).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-1: All ALTER TABLE migrations idempotent on repeated init_schema() via try/except sqlite3.OperationalError.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_migration.py::test_init_schema_idempotent + tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestSchema::test_init_schema_is_idempotent (row counts preserved). Live double-init smoke green for both tables.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-2: Schema-pin tests updated — EXPECTED_PENDING has model_fingerprint; EXPECTED_PENDING_COLUMNS and EXPECTED_PUBLISHED_COLUMNS updated.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestCrossSourceDedupSchemaPin::test_expected_pending_includes_model_fingerprint + ::test_expected_published_includes_model_fingerprint + TestInsertPendingFingerprint::test_pending_json_cols_registers_model_fingerprint (T8 M2 hardening). tests/test_migration.py::test_pending_articles_has_expected_columns + ::test_published_articles_has_expected_columns assert full column-set + per-column shape (litmus: dropping the ALTER fails the set-equality assert).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-3: pytest -q green including all new tests (model_extractor, backfill, admin_alerts, integration TestCrossSourceDedup, migration, pending_articles_repo).
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Full suite 1083 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed. Feature subset alone 143 passed.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-4: No regressions in existing tests (1012+ at HEAD pass).
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: 1083 passed = baseline 1012 (pre-feature) + ~71 new feature tests; 0 failed. Test count grew well above the +20 floor noted in the task; coverage growth healthy.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-5: Performance — extract_fingerprint <10ms on 10KB body; full dedup stage <100ms per article.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Treated as not_verifiable per Decision 3 / task Details — guaranteed CONSTRUCTIVELY via bounded quantifiers (ReDoS-safe regex) + structural window-bounded queries, NOT via wall-clock CI asserts (avoids flakiness). Structural guards: tests/test_model_extractor.py::TestExtractFingerprint::test_long_body_no_hang (10KB body completes) + tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestListRecentFingerprints window tests (bounded candidate set). Empirical backing: security-audit.md Focus 2 measured worst-case 1.87ms on 10KB adversarial input across all 3 regexes (3 orders of magnitude under budget). Considered met constructively; criterion is sound.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-6: No new external dependencies in requirements.txt.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: diff of requirements.txt vs pre-feature baseline (git show b891885:requirements.txt) => EMPTY (no diff). Also empty vs HEAD. Stdlib re/json/set/datetime/sqlite3 only.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-7: Backfill idempotent — second run on same DB skips processed rows, summary Processed: 0.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_backfill_fingerprints.py::test_idempotency_second_run_processed_zero. Idempotency marker WHERE model_fingerprint IS NULL (Decision 10). Dry-run smoke confirmed summary structure with Processed/Skipped counters.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-8: E016 rate-limit — consecutive calls within an hour send the ping exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py::TestDedupDegradedRateLimit::test_degraded_rate_limit_within_hour_true + ::after_hour_false (backdated bot_state, no time.sleep) + unset_returns_false + corrupted_timestamp_does_not_block. Integration: TestCrossSourceDedup::test_degraded_mode asserts exactly one E016 across two job() runs within the hour.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-9: Migration block survives init_db() called twice with no warning/error in logs.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_migration.py::TestMigration::test_init_db_idempotent passes (double init_db, no raise). Per-statement try/except sqlite3.OperationalError swallows the duplicate-column attempt silently (Decision 11).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-10: deploy.sh FILES list contains model_extractor.py AND backfill_fingerprints.py (else prod ImportError on first tick).
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: grep -nE 'model_extractor.py|backfill_fingerprints.py' deploy.sh => line 56 "model_extractor.py", line 57 "backfill_fingerprints.py" (both in FILES list). Also confirmed by security-audit.md verified-invariant 8.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC-tech-11: backfill_fingerprints.py imports news_bot BEFORE logging.basicConfig() (so _TokenRedactingFilter attaches to root logger).
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: grep: 'import news_bot' at line 72; 'logging.basicConfig(' at line 219 (inside main()) — import precedes basicConfig. Confirmed by security-audit.md verified-invariant 1 (runtime filter-chain inspection).

coverageCheck.details: Every Tasks 1-5 file has a corresponding test file and each passed AC ties to a behavior-exercising test (not import-only): model_extractor.py -> tests/test_model_extractor.py (29 tests, real extract+similarity); backfill_fingerprints.py -> tests/test_backfill_fingerprints.py (11 tests, real extractor+repo wiring, persisted DB-state asserts); pending_articles_repo.py -> tests/test_pending_articles_repo.py + tests/test_migration.py (62 tests, DB roundtrip + schema-pin + rate-limit window-expiry); admin_alerts.py -> tests/test_admin_alerts.py (test_e014/e015/e016, content asserts); news_bot.py (_check_cross_source_dedup gate) -> tests/test_integration.py::TestCrossSourceDedup + TestFingerprintCarryThrough (8 scenarios on real job() loop, DB-state + ping introspection); deploy.sh -> verified by grep (FILES list contains both new files). No feature file lacks tests.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: AC-tech-5: Performance budget — extract_fingerprint <10ms on 10KB body; full dedup stage <100ms per article.
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: By design there are no wall-clock CI assertions (Decision 3 — avoids flakiness). Guaranteed constructively via bounded quantifiers + window-bounded queries; empirically backed by security-audit 1.87ms/10KB. Live confirmation under prod article volume is optional.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: Live prod tick processing real articles after deploy.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: Optional: time a few news_bot.job() ticks on VPS (journalctl timing) and confirm no perceptible per-article slowdown. No hard gate.

deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Requires the live prod DB (published_articles with 14 days of real rows) and live source re-fetch via fetch_full_article. Pre-deploy verified only structurally on an empty/seeded test DB.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: First deploy completed; VPS SSH session; prod news.db migrated by first cron tick.

Then sqlite3 /home/hwbot/bot/news.db 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM published_articles WHERE model_fingerprint IS NOT NULL' matches expected backfilled count. Re-run NULL rows after Cloudflare cooldown if Errors>0.
